Information how picrust2 works and what the output is: [PICRUSt2 Tutorial (v2.1.3 beta) · picrust/picrust2 Wiki · GitHub](https://github.com/picrust/picrust2/wiki/PICRUSt2-Tutorial-(v2.1.3-beta)#picrust2-pipeline)

EC_predicted.tsv = In this table the predicted copy number of all Enzyme Classification (EC) numbers is shown for each ASV

EC_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv = overall EC number abundances per sample

EC_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_strat.tsv = EC number abundances per sample stratified by the contributing ASVs.

EC_metagenome_out/seqtab_norm.tsv = the ASV abundance table normalized by predicted 16S copy number

EC_metagenome_out/ weighted_nsti.tsv = the mean NSTI value per sample (when taking into account the relative abundance of th eASVs). This file can be useful for identifying outlier samples in the dataset. in PICRUSt1 NSTI value \< 0.06 and \> 0.15 were suggested as good and high, respectively.

Maaslin3:

Different from other differential abundance tools, low prevalence features need not be filtered out since the prevalence modeling in MaAsLin 3 already accounts for high proportions of zeros. However, filtering low prevalence features might improve power.

There are also a few rules of thumb to keep in mind.

- Models should ideally have about 10 times as many samples (all samples for logistic fits, non-zero samples for linear fits) as covariate terms (all continuous variables plus all categorical variable levels).

- Coefficients (effect sizes) larger than about 15 in absolute value are usually suspect unless very small unstandardized predictors are being included. (A coefficient of 15 corresponds to a fold change \>30000!). If you encounter such coefficients, check that (1) no error was thrown, (2) the diagnostics look reasonable, (3) a sufficient number of samples were used in fitting, (4) the q-value is significant, (5) the metadata are not highly collinear, and (6) the random effects are plausible.

Maaslin3 Model Selection Strategy\
In Maaslin3, you specify:

- `fixed_effects`: variables you want to test or control for

- `random_effects`: grouping variables to account for non-independence (e.g., repeated measures)

Based on this, I selected site (city: WAT, KIT, CAL, HESP) as random factors. However, we only have 4 levels in site, therefore I will try and run it with small_random_effects=TRUE, as otherwise the model may be too unstable. Another alternative would be to run all as fixed levels.

**Output directory**

```{r}

output_dir <- "R_output"  
```

## Loading the data from PICRUSt2

This is based on the default MetaCyc output that picrust gives. Alternative is using KEGG database and KO abundances.

Load from metagenome_out (KO)

```{r}
# load metacyc pathway
abundance_df <- read_delim("data/newpicrust2_out_pipeline-20251218/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat_metacyc.tsv",
  delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE, escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE
)

```

```{r}


library(tidyverse)

metadata <- read.csv("data\\KK-Brittany-sample info sheet June2023.csv")

# Replace dots with underscores
names(metadata) <- gsub("\\.", "_", names(metadata))

# Remove trailing underscores (1 or more)
names(metadata) <- gsub("_+$", "", names(metadata))

# modifying data
metadata$Lifestage <- factor(metadata$Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"),ordered = FALSE)

contrasts(metadata$Lifestage) <- contr.treatment(3)


abundance_samples <- colnames(abundance_df)[-1]   # remove "function."

metadata <- metadata[metadata$Study_ID %in% abundance_samples, ]

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Study_ID

# Factor assignments
metadata$Lifestage <- factor(metadata$Lifestage)
metadata$Taxa <- factor(metadata$Taxa)
metadata$Location <- factor(metadata$Location)
metadata$Site <- factor(metadata$Site)


# Set pathway as rownames and transpose
abundance_mat <- abundance_df %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "description") %>%  # pathways as rownames
  t() %>%                                  # transpose to samples x features
  as.data.frame()

# Convert all columns to numeric after transposing
abundance_mat <- abundance_mat %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# Keep only samples present in metadata
abundance_mat <- abundance_mat[rownames(metadata), ]


all(rownames(abundance_mat) == rownames(metadata))

output_full <- file.path(output_dir, "PICRUSt2_MaAsLin3")
```

## MAaslin3 - pathways across the whole data

```{r filter-full-data}

output_full <- file.path(output_dir, "PICRUSt2_MaAsLin3")

# If exists, delete
if (dir.exists(output_full)) unlink(output_full, recursive = TRUE)

# Create fresh folder
dir.create(output_full, recursive = TRUE)

#--------------------------------------------------

#FIlter low abundance pathways:
keep <- colSums(abundance_mat > 0)/nrow(abundance_mat) > 0.1
abundance_mat_filtered <- abundance_mat[, keep]


# Total number of pathways before filtering
total_pathways <- ncol(abundance_mat)

# Number of pathways kept
kept_pathways <- sum(keep)

# Number of pathways removed
removed_pathways <- total_pathways - kept_pathways

# Percentage kept/removed
percent_kept <- round(kept_pathways / total_pathways * 100, 1)
percent_removed <- round(removed_pathways / total_pathways * 100, 1)

cat("Total pathways:", total_pathways, "\n")
cat("Kept pathways:", kept_pathways, "(", percent_kept, "% )\n")
cat("Removed pathways:", removed_pathways, "(", percent_removed, "% )\n")



# Store original MetaCyc pathway names
original_pathways <- colnames(abundance_mat_filtered)

# Create safe internal IDs
safe_ids <- paste0("PATH_", seq_along(original_pathways))

# Apply safe IDs
colnames(abundance_mat_filtered) <- safe_ids

# Create lookup table
pathway_key <- data.frame(
  Safe_ID = safe_ids,
  MetaCyc_Pathway = original_pathways,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Save the key so nothing is ever lost
write.csv(pathway_key,
          file.path(output_full, "Pathway_Name_Key.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```

### Run full community model

```{r, eval=FALSE}
fit <- maaslin3(
  input_data = abundance_mat_filtered,
  input_metadata = metadata,
  output = output_full,
  fixed_effects = c("Location", "Taxa", "Lifestage"),  # fixed effects
  random_effects = c("Site"),                           # random effect
  normalization = "TSS",    # total sum scaling
  transform = "LOG",        # log transform abundance
  standardize = TRUE,
  small_random_effects = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.05         # 0.1 optional for exploratory analysis
)

```

### Run full model on macroinvertebrates only (as am getting the rank deficient error by maaslin)

```{r}

output_macro <- file.path(output_dir, "PICRUSt2_MaAsLin3_macroinv")
if (dir.exists(output_macro)) unlink(output_macro, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(output_macro, recursive = TRUE)

#--------------------------------------------------

metadata_no_spiders <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Lifestage != "Spider") %>%
  droplevels()

samples_keep <- rownames(metadata_no_spiders)

abundance_no_spiders <- abundance_mat_filtered[samples_keep, ]


fit <- maaslin3(
  input_data = abundance_no_spiders,
  input_metadata = metadata_no_spiders,
  output = output_macro,
  fixed_effects = c("Location", "Taxa", "Lifestage"),  # fixed effects
  random_effects = c("Site"),                           # random effect
  normalization = "TSS",    # total sum scaling
  transform = "LOG",        # log transform abundance
  standardize = TRUE,
  small_random_effects = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.05,         # 0.1 optional for exploratory analysis
  median_comparison_abundance = TRUE)
```

##### Summary table

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# File
results_file <- file.path(output_macro, "all_results.tsv")

# Read in results
maaslin_results <- read_tsv(results_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Restore original pathway names
pathway_key <- read.csv(file.path(output_full, "Pathway_Name_Key.csv"))

maaslin_results <- maaslin_results %>%
  left_join(pathway_key, by = c("feature" = "Safe_ID"))

head(maaslin_results)


# Define significance threshold
qval_cutoff <- 0.05

sig_results <- maaslin_results %>%
  filter(qval_joint <= qval_cutoff)

# Check how many significant hits
nrow(sig_results)
head(sig_results)

# Significant results only
write.csv(sig_results,
          file.path(output_macro, "MaAsLin_significant_results_q0.05.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

##### Plot Association plots

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

min_effect <- 0.75   # minimum absolute MaAsLin coefficient to plot
alpha_sig  <- 0.05   # q-value threshold

#Filter sig results
sig_results_filtered <- sig_results %>%
  filter(
    qval_joint <= alpha_sig,
    is.na(error),
    abs(coef) >= min_effect
  )


# aAbundance matrix → TSS + log2 + median centering + SD

abundance_mat <- abundance_no_spiders  # or abundance_spiders

# TSS normalization
abundance_tss <- sweep(abundance_mat, 1, rowSums(abundance_mat), FUN = "/")

# Log2 transform with pseudo-count
abundance_log <- log2(abundance_tss + 1e-5)


# long foramt and metadata
abundance_long <- abundance_log %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample_ID,
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample_ID" = "Study_ID")) %>%
  mutate(
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider")),
    Taxa     = factor(Taxa, levels = c("Chironomidae", "Hydropsychidae", "Heptageniidae",
                                      "Tetragnatha", "Araneid")),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
  )

#helper function
make_safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>% gsub(" ", "_", .) %>% gsub("/", "_", .) %>% gsub(":", "_", .)
}

q_to_stars <- function(q) {
  case_when(
    q <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    q <= 0.01  ~ "**",
    q <= 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE       ~ ""
  )
}

#output folder
plot_base <- file.path(output_macro, "Association_Plots_all")
if (dir.exists(plot_base)) unlink(plot_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
dir.create(plot_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

#group results
grouped_results <- sig_results_filtered %>%
  group_by(feature, metadata, model) %>%
  group_split()

#plotting loop
for (grp in grouped_results) {

  pathway    <- unique(grp$feature)
  factor_nm  <- unique(grp$metadata)
  model_type <- unique(grp$model)
  pathway_nm <- unique(grp$MetaCyc_Pathway)

  df_plot <- abundance_long %>% filter(feature == pathway)
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next

  safe_name <- make_safe_filename(pathway_nm)
  ref_level <- levels(df_plot[[factor_nm]])[1]

  linear_dir   <- file.path(plot_base, factor_nm, "Linear")
  logistic_dir <- file.path(plot_base, factor_nm, "Logistic")
  dir.create(linear_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(logistic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  #------------------------------------
  # Add (n=) counts to x-axis labels
  n_per_level <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")"))

  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    left_join(n_per_level, by = setNames(factor_nm, factor_nm))

  # Ensure label_x is a factor in the right order
df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = factor(label_x, levels = n_per_level %>%
                                       mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
                                       pull(label_x))
  )
  
  # Linear  model
  if (model_type == "abundance") {

  # Compute counts per factor level for (n=)
  n_per_level <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")"))

  
  # Prepare significance annotations
  # Calculate max per group
# Calculate top per group and add proportional offset
y_positions <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(n_per_level, by = setNames(factor_nm, factor_nm)) %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos = y_max + 2   # adjust spacing if needed
  )

sig_annot <- grp %>%
  filter(value != ref_level) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = q_to_stars(qval_joint),
    label = paste0(stars, "\ncoef = ", round(coef, 2))
  ) %>%
  left_join(y_positions, by = c("value" = factor_nm)) %>%
  mutate(value = label_x)

 # add the q-value for subtitle (take first or min)
  fdr_value <- signif(min(grp$qval_joint, na.rm = TRUE), 3)  # e.g., 1.23e-8


  # Add a column to use the pathway name as y-axis label
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(pathway_label = pathway_nm)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = label_x, y = abundance, fill = .data[[factor_nm]])) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  geom_text(
  data = sig_annot,
  aes(x = value, y = y_pos, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 3.5,
  vjust = 1   # anchors text "on" the y_pos
) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
 # scale_y_reverse() +   #  reverse y-axis
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = pathway_nm,   # keep title as before
    subtitle = paste(" |coef| ≥", min_effect, " | FDR = ", fdr_value),
    x = factor_nm,
    y = "Log2(rel. abundance + 1e-5)"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Association_", safe_name, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    path = linear_dir,
    width = 6,
    height = 4.5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
########################################################|
# Prevalence model plotting

if (model_type %in% c("prevalence", "logistic")) {

  # Convert abundance to presence/absence
  df_prev <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(
      presence = ifelse(abundance > 0, 1, 0)  # 1 = Present, 0 = Absent
    )

  # Compute prevalence per factor level
  prevalence_df <- df_prev %>%
    group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
    summarize(prevalence = mean(presence), .groups = "drop")

  # Prepare significance annotations
  sig_annot <- grp %>%
    filter(value != ref_level) %>%
    mutate(
      stars = q_to_stars(qval_joint),
      label = paste0(stars, "\ncoef = ", round(coef, 2))
    ) %>%
    left_join(n_per_level, by = c("value" = factor_nm)) %>%
    mutate(value = label_x)

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(prevalence_df, aes(x = .data[[factor_nm]], y = prevalence)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#66C2A5", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
    # Optional: overlay jittered points for individual samples
    geom_jitter(data = df_prev, aes(x = .data[[factor_nm]], y = presence),
                width = 0.2, height = 0.02, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "darkblue") +
    # Add significance annotations
    geom_text(data = sig_annot, aes(x = value, y = 1.05, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5, vjust = 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1.15)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = pathway_nm,
      subtitle = paste("Prevalence model | Median-centered test | |coef| ≥", min_effect),
      x = factor_nm,
      y = "Proportion present"
    )

  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Association_", safe_name, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    path = logistic_dir,
    width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
}


}

```

##### Create summary table for top associations

“Top associations” = **The N associations with the largest combined biological and statistical evidence** *within a given metadata variable and model.“Top associations were ranked using a composite score combining absolute effect size and false discovery rate (\|β\| × −log10(FDR)).”*

```{r}

#  Summary of results with relative abundances for all levels

#select number of top associations
top_asso_nbr=20



# First, identify all metadata factors tested
tested_metadata <- unique(sig_results_filtered$metadata)

# Create an empty list to store top associations per metadata and model
top_assoc_list <- list()

for (meta in tested_metadata) {
  
  for (mod in c("abundance", "prevalence")) {
    
    # Subset significant results for this metadata and model
    sig_meta <- sig_results_filtered %>%
  filter(metadata == meta, model == mod) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_coef = abs(coef),
    rank_score = abs(coef) * -log10(qval_joint)
  )
    
    if(nrow(sig_meta) == 0) next  # skip if none
    
    # Get top 20 strongest associations by absolute coefficient
    top_meta <- sig_meta %>%
      slice_max(order_by = rank_score, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_coef))
    
    # Compute mean relative abundance for each level of this metadata
    abundance_means <- abundance_long %>%
      filter(feature %in% top_meta$feature) %>%
      group_by(feature, meta_level = .data[[meta]]) %>%
      summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = meta_level, values_from = mean_abundance)
    
    # Join abundances with top_meta
    top_meta_with_abund <- top_meta %>%
      left_join(abundance_means, by = "feature") %>%
      mutate(model = mod)
    
    top_assoc_list[[paste(meta, mod, sep = "_")]] <- top_meta_with_abund
  }
}

# Combine all metadata and model summaries
top_assoc_all <- bind_rows(top_assoc_list)


file_name <- paste0("Top", top_asso_nbr, "_strongest_associations_by_model.csv")

# Save CSV directly inside plot_base
write.csv(
  top_assoc_all,
  file.path(plot_base, file_name),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Preview in console
message_txt <- paste0(
  "=== Top ", top_asso_nbr, 
  " strongest associations per metadata and model with mean relative abundances per factor level ==="
)

print(message_txt)
print(top_assoc_all)
```

##### Plot compare Up vs down

```{r}

  )

# Abundance matrix → TSS + log2 + median centering + SD


# TSS normalization
abundance_tss <- sweep(abundance_spiders, 1, rowSums(abundance_spiders), FUN = "/")

# Log2 transform with pseudo-count
abundance_log <- log2(abundance_tss + 1e-5)


abundance_long <- abundance_log %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample_ID,
    names_to = "feature",

  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample_ID" = "Study_ID")) %>%
  # Keep only the spider taxa
  filter(Taxa %in% c("Tetragnatha", "Araneid")) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa = factor(
      Taxa,
      levels = c("Tetragnatha", "Araneid")
    ),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
  )
#helper function
make_safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("/", "_", .) %>%
    gsub(":", "_", .)
}

q_to_stars <- function(q) {
  case_when(
    q <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    q <= 0.01  ~ "**",
    q <= 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE       ~ ""
  )
}



plot_base <- file.path(output_spider, "Association_Plots_all")
# Remove folder if it exists (overwrite)
if (dir.exists(plot_base)) {
  unlink(plot_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
}

# Then recreate
dir.create(plot_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

#group maaslin results
grouped_results <- sig_results_filtered %>%
  group_by(feature, metadata, model) %>%
  group_split()

#plot loop
for (grp in grouped_results) {

  pathway    <- unique(grp$feature)
  factor_nm  <- unique(grp$metadata)
  model_type <- unique(grp$model)
  pathway_nm <- unique(grp$MetaCyc_Pathway)

  df_plot <- abundance_long %>% filter(feature == pathway)

  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) next

  safe_name <- make_safe_filename(pathway_nm)

  ref_level <- levels(df_plot[[factor_nm]])[1]

  linear_dir   <- file.path(plot_base, factor_nm, "Linear")
  logistic_dir <- file.path(plot_base, factor_nm, "Logistic")

  dir.create(linear_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(logistic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
  
  #------------------------------------
  # Add (n=) counts to x-axis labels
  n_per_level <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")"))
  
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    left_join(n_per_level, by = setNames(factor_nm, factor_nm))
  
  # Ensure label_x is a factor in the right order
  df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    mutate(
      label_x = factor(label_x, levels = n_per_level %>%
                         mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
                         pull(label_x))
    )
  
  #Abundace linear model
   if (model_type == "abundance") {
    
    # Compute counts per factor level for (n=)
    n_per_level <- df_plot %>%
      group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(label_x = paste0(.data[[factor_nm]], " (n=", n, ")"))
    
    
    # Prepare significance annotations
    # Calculate max per group
    # Calculate top per group and add proportional offset
    y_positions <- df_plot %>%
      group_by(.data[[factor_nm]]) %>%
      summarise(y_max = max(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(n_per_level, by = setNames(factor_nm, factor_nm)) %>%
      mutate(
        y_pos = y_max + 2   # adjust spacing if needed
      )
    
    sig_annot <- grp %>%
      filter(value != ref_level) %>%
      mutate(
        stars = q_to_stars(qval_joint),
        label = paste0(stars, "\ncoef = ", round(coef, 2))
      ) %>%
      left_join(y_positions, by = c("value" = factor_nm)) %>%
      mutate(value = label_x)
    
    # add the q-value for subtitle (take first or min)
    fdr_value <- signif(min(grp$qval_joint, na.rm = TRUE), 3)  # e.g., 1.23e-8
    
    
    # Add a column to use the pathway name as y-axis label
    df_plot <- df_plot %>%
      mutate(pathway_label = pathway_nm)
    
    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = label_x, y = abundance, fill = .data[[factor_nm]])) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.6) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
      geom_text(
        data = sig_annot,
        aes(x = value, y = y_pos, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3.5,
        vjust = 1   # anchors text "on" the y_pos
      ) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      # scale_y_reverse() +   # <-- reverse y-axis
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = pathway_nm,   # keep title as before
        subtitle = paste(" |coef| ≥", min_effect, " | FDR = ", fdr_value),
        x = factor_nm,
        y = "Log2(rel. abundance + 1e-5)"
      )
    
    
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("Association_", safe_name, ".png"),
      plot = p,
      path = linear_dir,
      width = 6,
      height = 4.5,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }

  #Prevalence ( logistic model)
  if (model_type %in% c("prevalence", "logistic")) {

    outdir <- logistic_dir

    df_prev <- df_plot %>%
      mutate(
        presence = factor(
          ifelse(abundance > 0, "Present", "Absent"),
          levels = c("Absent", "Present")
        )
      )

    sig_annot <- grp %>%
      filter(value != ref_level) %>%
      mutate(
        stars = q_to_stars(qval_joint),
        label = paste0(
          stars,
          "\ncoef = ", round(coef, 2)
        )
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      df_prev,
      aes(
        x = .data[[factor_nm]],
        y = presence,
        fill = .data[[factor_nm]]
      )
    ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        alpha = 0.7,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        width = 0.6
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        aes(color = .data[[factor_nm]]),
        height = 0.15,
        width = 0.2,
        size = 1,
        alpha = 0.6,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = pathway_nm,
        subtitle = paste(
          "Prevalence model | Median-centered test | |coef| ≥",
          min_effect
        ),
        x = factor_nm,
        y = "Feature state"

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("Association_", safe_name, ".png"),
      plot = p,
      path = outdir,
      width = 6,
      height = 4.5,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }
  
}
```

##### Create summary table for top associations

```{r}
# Summary of results with relative abundances for all levels

#select number of top associations
top_asso_nbr=20


# First, identify all metadata factors tested
tested_metadata <- unique(sig_results_filtered$metadata)

# Create an empty list to store top associations per metadata and model
top_assoc_list <- list()

for (meta in tested_metadata) {
  
  for (mod in c("abundance", "prevalence")) {
    
    # Subset significant results for this metadata and model
    sig_meta <- sig_results_filtered %>%
      filter(metadata == meta, model == mod) %>%
      mutate(abs_coef = abs(coef))
    
    if(nrow(sig_meta) == 0) next  # skip if none
    
    # Get top 20 strongest associations by absolute coefficient
    top_meta <- sig_meta %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs_coef, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_coef))
    
    # Compute mean relative abundance for each level of this metadata
    abundance_means <- abundance_long %>%
      filter(feature %in% top_meta$feature) %>%
      group_by(feature, meta_level = .data[[meta]]) %>%
      summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = meta_level, values_from = mean_abundance)
    
    # Join abundances with top_meta
    top_meta_with_abund <- top_meta %>%
      left_join(abundance_means, by = "feature") %>%
      mutate(model = mod)
    
    top_assoc_list[[paste(meta, mod, sep = "_")]] <- top_meta_with_abund
  }
}

# Combine all metadata and model summaries
top_assoc_all <- bind_rows(top_assoc_list)

# Construct filename directly
file_name <- paste0("Top", top_asso_nbr, "_strongest_associations_by_model.csv")

# Save CSV directly inside plot_base
write.csv(
  top_assoc_all,
  file.path(plot_base, file_name),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Preview in console
message_txt <- paste0(
  "=== Top ", top_asso_nbr, 
  " strongest associations per metadata and model with mean relative abundances per factor level ==="
)

print(message_txt)
print(top_assoc_all)
```

```{r}
    } else {
      warning("Failed to remove: ", output_base)
    }
}

# Recreate the output folder cleanly

message("Output directory created: ", output_base)

  message("Processing: ", taxon)

  # Convert fixed effects to factors
meta_sub$Site <- factor(meta_sub$Site)
meta_sub$Location <- factor(meta_sub$Location)
meta_sub$Lifestage <- factor(meta_sub$Lifestage)
  
  # Skip if too few samples
  if (nrow(meta_sub) < 10) {
    message("  Skipping (too few samples)")
    next
  }

  if (length(unique(meta_sub$Lifestage)) < 2) {

    next
  }


 # Subset pathway table

percent_removed <- round(removed_pathways / total_pathways * 100, 1)

cat("Total pathways:", total_pathways, "\n")
cat("Kept pathways:", kept_pathways, "(", percent_kept, "% )\n")
cat("Removed pathways:", removed_pathways, "(", percent_removed, "% )\n")



  # Define output directory for taxon

  dir.create(output_dir_tax, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Run MaAsLin3

      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
      labs(
        title = pathway_nm,
        subtitle = paste("Prevalence model | Median-centered test | |coef| ≥", min_effect),
        x = factor_nm,
        y = "Feature state"
      )

    ggsave(filename = paste0("Association_", safe_name, ".png"),
           plot = p, path = logistic_dir, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
  }
}

#################################################

#SUMMARY TABLE

#################################################



# First, identify all metadata factors tested
tested_metadata <- unique(sig_results_filtered$metadata)

# Create an empty list to store top associations per metadata and model
top_assoc_list <- list()

for (meta in tested_metadata) {
  
  for (mod in c("abundance", "prevalence")) {
    
    # Subset significant results for this metadata and model
    sig_meta <- sig_results_filtered %>%
      filter(metadata == meta, model == mod) %>%
      mutate(abs_coef = abs(coef))
    
    if(nrow(sig_meta) == 0) next  # skip if none
    
    # Get top 20 strongest associations by absolute coefficient
    top_meta <- sig_meta %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs_coef, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_coef))
    
    # Compute mean relative abundance for each level of this metadata
    abundance_means <- abundance_long %>%
      filter(feature %in% top_meta$feature) %>%
      group_by(feature, meta_level = .data[[meta]]) %>%
      summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = meta_level, values_from = mean_abundance)
    
    # Join abundances with top_meta
    top_meta_with_abund <- top_meta %>%
      left_join(abundance_means, by = "feature") %>%
      mutate(model = mod)
    
    top_assoc_list[[paste(meta, mod, sep = "_")]] <- top_meta_with_abund
  }
}

# Combine all metadata and model summaries
top_assoc_all <- bind_rows(top_assoc_list)

# Construct filename directly
file_name <- paste0("Top", top_asso_nbr, paste0("_Taxon_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", taxon)), "_strongest_associations_by_model.csv")

# Save CSV directly inside plot_base
write.csv(
  top_assoc_all,
  file.path(plot_base, file_name),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Preview in console
message_txt <- paste0(
  "=== Top ", top_asso_nbr, 
  " strongest associations per metadata and model with mean relative abundances per factor level ==="
)

print(message_txt)
print(top_assoc_all)

#Summary barplot------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)

# Only continue if Location exists in tested metadata
if("Location" %in% top_assoc_all$metadata & "abundance" %in% top_assoc_all$model) {

  top_location <- top_assoc_all %>%
    filter(metadata == "Location", model == "abundance") %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs_coef, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_coef)) %>%
    mutate(
      feature = factor(MetaCyc_Pathway, levels = MetaCyc_Pathway),
      direction = ifelse(coef > 0, "UP", "DWN")
    )

  # Pivot only existing mean abundance columns (UP/DWN)
  abund_cols <- intersect(c("UP", "DWN"), colnames(top_location))

  if(length(abund_cols) > 0) {
    abund_long <- top_location %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(abund_cols), names_to = "Location_level", values_to = "mean_abundance")

    # Make plot
    p <- ggplot(top_location, aes(x = feature, y = coef, fill = direction)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "#1f78b4", "DWN" = "#e31a1c")) +
      labs(
        x = "Pathway",
        y = "Effect size (coef)",
        fill = "Location"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
      )

    print(p)

    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("DAA_sum_plot_top", top_asso_nbr,"_UPvsDWN_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", taxon), ".png"),
      plot = p,
      path = output_dir_tax,
      width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
    )
  } else {
    message("  No UP/DWN columns present for plotting Location effect.")
  }
} else {
  message("  No significant Location abundance results to plot for this taxon.")
}

#SSummary bar plot for top Lifestage effects (Larvae vs Adult)
#----------------------------------------
if("Lifestage" %in% top_assoc_all$metadata & "abundance" %in% top_assoc_all$model) {

  # Check if both levels are present
  lifestage_levels <- intersect(c("Larvae", "Adult"), colnames(top_assoc_all))
  if(length(lifestage_levels) == 2) {

    top_life <- top_assoc_all %>%
      filter(metadata == "Lifestage", model == "abundance") %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs_coef, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_coef)) %>%
      mutate(
        feature = factor(MetaCyc_Pathway, levels = MetaCyc_Pathway),
        direction = ifelse(coef > 0, "Adult", "Larvae")
      )

    # Pivot only existing columns for mean abundance
    abund_cols <- intersect(c("Adult", "Larvae"), colnames(top_life))
    abund_long <- top_life %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(abund_cols), names_to = "Lifestage_level", values_to = "mean_abundance")

    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(top_life, aes(x = feature, y = coef, fill = direction)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#1f78b4", "Larvae" = "#e31a1c")) +
      labs(
        x = "Pathway",
        y = "Effect size (coef)",
        fill = "Lifestage"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
      )

    print(p)

    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("DAA_sum_plot_top", top_asso_nbr,"_AdultvsLarvae_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", taxon), ".png"),
      plot = p,
      path = output_dir_tax,
      width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
    )

  } else {
    message("  Skipping Lifestage plot: not both Larvae and Adult present.")
  }

} else {
  message("  No significant Lifestage abundance results to plot for this taxon.")
}


 }
```

## MaAsLin3 -pathways by sample type

```{r}
sample_type_list <- unique(metadata$Sample_Type)

min_effect   <- 0.75
alpha_sig    <- 0.05
top_asso_nbr <- 20

output_base <- file.path(output_dir, "PICRUSt2_MaAsLin3_by_sample_type")

if (dir.exists(output_base)) unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE)

# Loop over sampe types
for (stype in sample_type_list) {

  message("Processing Sample_Type: ", stype)


  # Subset metadata
  meta_sub <- metadata %>%
    filter(Sample_Type == stype)

  meta_sub$Site     <- factor(meta_sub$Site)
  meta_sub$Location <- factor(meta_sub$Location)

  if (nrow(meta_sub) < 10) {
    message("  Skipping (too few samples)")
    next
  }

  if (length(unique(meta_sub$Location)) < 2) {
    message("  Skipping (only one location)")
    next
  }

  # Subset abundance
  abundance_mat_sub <- abundance_mat_filtered[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  keep <- colSums(abundance_mat_sub > 0)/nrow(abundance_mat_sub) > 0.1
  abundance_mat_sub_filtered <- abundance_mat_sub[, keep]

#output
  output_dir_stype <- file.path(
    output_base,
    paste0("SampleType_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", stype))
  )
  dir.create(output_dir_stype, showWarnings = FALSE)

  #Run maaslin
  fit <- maaslin3(
    input_data = abundance_mat_sub_filtered,
    input_metadata = meta_sub,
    output = output_dir_stype,
    fixed_effects = "Location",
    random_effects = "Site",
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    standardize = TRUE,
    small_random_effects = TRUE
  )

  # Results
  res_file <- file.path(output_dir_stype, "all_results.tsv")
  res <- read_tsv(res_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  pathway_key <- read.csv(file.path(output_full, "Pathway_Name_Key.csv"))
  res <- res %>% left_join(pathway_key, by = c("feature" = "Safe_ID"))

  sig_results <- res %>%
    filter(qval_joint <= alpha_sig)

  write.csv(
    sig_results,
    file.path(output_dir_stype, "Significant_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # abundance long
  abundance_long <- abundance_mat_sub_filtered %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Sample_ID, names_to = "feature", values_to = "abundance") %>%
    left_join(meta_sub, by = c("Sample_ID" = "Study_ID")) %>%
    mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN")))

  # Top assiciation (Location only)
  top_location <- sig_results %>%
    filter(model == "abundance",
           metadata == "Location",
           abs(coef) >= min_effect) %>%
    mutate(abs_coef = abs(coef)) %>%
    slice_max(abs_coef, n = top_asso_nbr, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_coef))

  write.csv(
    top_location,
    file.path(output_dir_stype,
              paste0("Top", top_asso_nbr, "_Location_associations.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  #mean abundance per location
  abundance_means <- abundance_long %>%
    filter(feature %in% top_location$feature) %>%
    group_by(feature, Location) %>%
    summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Location,
                values_from = mean_abundance)

  top_location <- top_location %>%
    left_join(abundance_means, by = "feature")

  # Summary bar plot
  plot_df <- top_location %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = fct_reorder(MetaCyc_Pathway, coef),
      direction = ifelse(coef > 0, "UP", "DWN")
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df,
              aes(x = MetaCyc_Pathway,
                  y = coef,
                  fill = direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("UP" = "#1f78b4",
                                 "DWN" = "#e31a1c")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top Location effects –", stype),
      x = "Pathway",
      y = "Effect size (MaAsLin coef)",
      fill = "Higher in"
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("DAA_Top", top_asso_nbr,
                      "_Location_", stype, ".png"),
    plot = p,
    path = output_dir_stype,
    width = 9,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
